scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-watchtowers-wp-1-37-to-1-38-watch.story: From Neuwied it runs 69 km to Neuwied; allow about 1 h 11 of riding. On the way it passes Watchtower WP 1/65, Watchtowers WP 2/2 to 2/4 and back through Watchtower WP 1/65. The line favours views over speed.
